title: Troubleshoot Disk Usage and Data Retention
objectives: Troubleshoot Disk Usage and Data Retention
Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: Inspect actual ops_logs buckets and bytes in Settings → Indexes. This is a clustered index; change its native definition in cm01 /opt/splunk/etc/manager-apps/_cluster/local/indexes.conf and distribute the manager bundle. Preserve the other indexes.

For ops_logs set coldToFrozenDir=/var/archive/ops_logs, frozenTimePeriodInSecs=1 and maxHotIdleSecs=1, then apply the bundle. Advance two ticks and verify the recorded bucket froze with an archive. Restore it using the recorded bucket control in Settings → Indexes, then search index=ops_logs | stats count and open Job Inspector. Thawed records must return count=3; this exercise does not model an arbitrary OS filesystem.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.
